items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: McCurdy's boys, eh? Mm-hmm. ... I know they used to have some McCurdy's from Algeys students to play music.

ctx.x: Do you remember the Peerless band, McCurdy and...
McCurdy's, McCurdy's boys, eh? Mm-hmm. Well, wait, let me tell you.
The fellow worked with him on piccolo too, Bab Frank, I think.
